selection_order: fine_multiple_ids AND positive Fine shuffle MSE contribution above 1e-8
same-context K2048 minus K1024 global PSNR gain descending
decoder_prerequisite: Fine uses multiple actual transmitted IDs and shuffling those IDs measurably increases same-state MSE
stop: If neither selected model restores useful Fine at cumulative update 1000, keep negative results and do not run decoder expansion, 3000/5000-step training, data downloads, or 30FPS optimization.
uncertainty: One common initialization seed. Matched controlled pilot, not a multi-seed convergence claim.
bitstream: ATHR v1 fixed 13-bit layout unchanged. Deterministic positions select the per-level book; no per-token level field. Config and all codebook weights participate in model/header identities, which reject old or differently configured models. No silent identity fallback.
